notes.title: So the Journey Begins!
notes.content:
What would happen if a person who could not find a job, suddenly became a hiring manager in a fantasy world? That’s the concept behind My Lord Is Hiring—a job interview simulator set in a realm of swords and sorcery.

In My Lord Is Hiring, you’re transported to another world and become a hiring manager, holding the power to decide people’s fates: hire, reject, or even fire. Your goal is to complete missions by assigning the right employees for each task, all while defending the kingdom from an impending demon invasion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266608/8761990811f2fdbb149027147cbe7d8dc074cfeb.gif



We’re excited to announce that our Steam page is now live!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266608/521bef627dfedcf5820a422dc0fb7ea1bbdb7ecc.png

This marks the beginning of our journey to create something we hope will resonate with you.

Please consider wishlisting the game—we’ll keep you updated on our progress and share sneak peeks along the way.

Also, join us on our Discord server for a chance to play early as a tester!
